limitations: Unused channels are declared in the builder input and omitted from the final SDRF.
Pooled-reference channels have not applicable medium and oxygen factors because their constituent conditions are not resolved by the deposit.
The evidenced yeast strain is retained in this report rather than an SDRF characteristic because the resolved ms-proteomics template does not license a yeast strain-or-breed column.
The publication specifies CID MS2 with SPS-HCD MS3; the SDRF's single dissociation-method field records CID MS2, while the SPS-HCD MS3 stage is retained here as a representational limitation.
